name: s81lk_rate_match-ec1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link rate-match leaf (one per SerDes and per UCIe link macro), never kitted before (census 10-16). Bench = standalone tb_s81_rate_match at +-1100 ppm both directions (24,000 data beats exact in order, no fault, 26 IDLE slips absorbed) + 2 source-copy mutants (data-beat drop, no IDLE insert).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_rate_match u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_pdie_serdes.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_rate_match/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_rate_match/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_rate_match --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_rate_match  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW leaf (ELEM-CENSUS 10-16, census class F, S-DIE ok 12:20): S81 link rate matcher ot_s81_rate_match (8-deep gray-pointer FIFO, recovered clock -> local clock, IDLE-beat drop at fill >= 6 / IDLE insert on empty, sticky fault on a lost data beat), real on-die digital sublayer inside BOTH ot_pdie_serdes and ot_pdie_ucie blackboxes (die_contracts.json two leaf rows, one master). Clocks: wclk = pma_rck (far die), rclk = local ck; plesiochronous (+-300 ppm, same nominal 833.333 ps). Timed as related_same_frequency (same_pll_fixed_phase 1/1 phase 0): every crossing (gray pointers, FIFO word -> r_d) gets ordinary one-cycle setup + hold, which bounds each crossing tighter than the gray FIFO needs; the async_gray_fifo admission is source-fingerprinted to the HBM FIFO only, and no false path / clock group is used. Outline from gate 1 (182141: ORFS synth 2,895 um2, placed std 3,324 um2 -> GPL util 104.9% in 43.2 x 86.4) re-sized to ~57% core util. S-DIE serdes/ucie macro boundary (physical/asap7_v41x_pdie_macros_v2/ot_pdie_serdes.lef, 250.056 x 2250.216 W/E link column, R0 = west column): PMA lanes / pads on the W (die-edge) face, the core-side beat bus on the E face (east column = MY mirror). w_v/w_d/wclk/wrst_n on W (from the KP4 decoder / UCIe PMA RX), r_d/fault/rclk/rrst_n on E (core-side rx bus).
